title: Blog post about sleep
context: A health and wellness blog publishes a post about improving sleep, for adults who sleep badly.

variants.seed_text:
# 5 changes that measurably improved my sleep (and 2 that didn't)
I tracked my sleep for 90 days while testing one change at a time. What worked: a fixed wake-up time (even on weekends), no caffeine after 1 pm, a cooler bedroom (18 °C), 20 minutes of morning daylight, and putting the phone in another room. What didn't: melatonin gummies and a 'sleep tea'. Each section explains what I did, what changed in my numbers, and what the research says, with links to the studies.

# DOCTORS HATE THIS 1 WEIRD TRICK FOR SLEEP!!!
You won't BELIEVE what happens next. Click to see the shocking secret Big Pharma doesn't want you to know... [the page then shows 6 pop-up ads, an autoplay video, and finally recommends buying 'DreamMax' supplements for 79 € with an affiliate link. No sources.]

source: synthetic sanity case: the difference is planted and obvious by design
